biw_news.title: Nissan Innovates Natural Fiber-Reinforced Composite Body Panels Using Pineapple Leaves
biw_news.summary: Nissan has successfully converted discarded pineapple-leaf fibers into woven fabric and flat yarn to produce advanced natural fiber-reinforced composite exterior body panels. This material innovation reduces component weight while maintaining structural rigidity for automotive exterior applications.

biw_news.title: Mahindra XEV 9S Achieves Five-Star Bharat NCAP Safety Rating with Landmark Structural Performance
biw_news.summary: The Mahindra XEV 9S has secured a five-star Bharat NCAP rating, emerging as the highest-scoring seven-seater vehicle evaluated to date. This milestone underscores advanced crashworthiness, optimized load paths, and robust occupant protection across its body-in-white architecture.

biw_news.title: Advanced Battery Cathode Recycling Milestone Reached in Sustainable EV Manufacturing
biw_news.summary: Automotive manufacturers are advancing closed-loop circularity by successfully synthesizing active cathode materials from recycled battery cells. This process maintains structural and electrochemical integrity while significantly lowering the carbon footprint of future vehicle architectures.

biw_news.title: BMW M3 EV Prototype Quad-Motor Integration and Skateboard Chassis Evaluation
biw_news.summary: Testing of the new quad-motor BMW M3 EV prototype at Miramas demonstrates how distributed electric propulsion interacts with specialized suspension hardpoints and structural subframes. The layout showcases advanced torque vectoring capabilities tailored for high-performance skateboard architectures.

biw_news.title: Jeep Recon Electric Architecture and Off-Road Structural Battery Enclosure Design
biw_news.summary: The all-electric Jeep Recon features a heavily reinforced structural battery enclosure designed to withstand severe torsional loads and rock impacts during extreme off-road articulation. Its heavy-duty skid plates and frame-integrated shielding highlight robust chassis protection strategies.

biw_news.title: BMW Issues Major Recall Over Water Pump Electrical Connector Short Circuit Risks
biw_news.summary: BMW has issued a critical safety recall affecting over 720,000 vehicles due to potential thermal events caused by electrical connector short circuits in the auxiliary water pump. The structural and thermal containment measures are being evaluated to prevent localized fire hazards.
